column2: the plan’s `/design` compression cut list targets the step 5c terminal-handoff cluster (no-recap rule, `final-summary-emit.md` verbatim emit, and **not** gated on `render-final-summary` exit 0) as shared-anchor duplication. that cluster is a skill-specific **critical/terminal** halt guard, not redundant rationale. step 5 body (lines 885+) repeats it, but that section may fall out of context after long step 3 review loops; the always-loaded banner (line 29) is the turn-n orchestration surface. cutting it risks free-form “design complete.” / cost-recap halts despite step 5c item 5.

the plan’s stated goal is to roughly halve both inline anti-halt banners (~377 words `/implement`, ~573 words `/design`), but the testing strategy only asserts `make lint` / `test-anti-halt-banners.sh` (contract token). an implementation can preserve the token and pass lint while trimming only a few words, missing the feature’s per-turn context-cost goal.

a one-line compressed step 5c cluster risks applying marker-first emit to both completed step 5c handoff and cancellation final-summary paths. the current banner separately requires cancellation outcomes to use the site-specific profile in `final-summary-emit.md` (file-only at step 0b cancel routes vs marker-first after completed background fences). over-compression can push operators to marker-first on file-only cancel exits.

the plan’s edge cases say “do not weaken immediate-background behavior” but do not name the banner-exclusive phrase `that yielding is not a halt`, which appears only in the always-loaded banner today (step 3/5c ib sections repeat it later; pre-step-3 paths have no other copy). the design banner keep list also omits explicit immediate-background semantics (in-flight yield after launch ack is not a halt) while the implement keep list names them. compression can rewrite ib semantics to “wait for `<task-notification>`” only and drop the explicit yield-is-not-halt rule, causing orchestrators to treat required end the turn yields after step 3/5c launch acks as halts again (#5240 class).

the plan’s “compressed step 5c / final-summary terminal boundary” bullet paraphrases the rule, but `scripts/test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh` (via `make lint`) grep-pins the exact substring `marker-first profile for completed step 5c task output when `_publish_rc` is 0, 1, or 3` only in the always-loaded banner; step 5d uses different wording. an implementer following the compressed bullet can pass `test-anti-halt-banners.sh` yet fail `make lint`.
